title: Tips for a trip to Hungary
situation: You have received an e-mail from your Irish friend, Tom, who is planning to visit Hungary next summer. Write a reply to Tom.
situationHu: Ír barátod, Tom, jövő nyáron Magyarországra jön, és tanácsot kér az utazáshoz; válaszolj neki e-mailben.
stimulus:
Hi!
Great news – my parents have finally said yes: I can visit Hungary next summer! I'll have about a week. When is the best time to come? What should I see? And how do people get around – is it easy to travel by train or bus? Any ideas would be great!
Tom

points.text: say when the best time to come is and why
recommend two places he should visit and say why
give him advice about travelling around the country
offer to do something together during his stay

usefulPhrases.en: Thanks for your e-mail – that's great news!
usefulPhrases.hu: Köszi az e-mailt – ez szuper hír!

usefulPhrases.en: The best time to come is … because …
usefulPhrases.hu: Akkor a legjobb jönni, amikor …, mert …

usefulPhrases.en: The easiest way to get around is by train.
You can buy tickets online or at the station.
usefulPhrases.hu: Jegyet vehetsz online vagy a pályaudvaron.

usefulPhrases.en: I could show you around my town.
Can't wait to see you! / Cheers,

checklistExtra: Tom mindhárom kérdésére (mikor jöjjön, mit nézzen meg, hogyan utazzon) válaszoltam?

modelAnswer.text:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for your e-mail – that's great news! The best time to come is June, because it's warm but not too hot, and there aren't as many tourists as in August.

You really should see Budapest, especially the Parliament and the view from Gellért Hill. You should also visit Lake Balaton, which is famous for its beaches.

The easiest way to get around is by train. Trains are cheap and quite comfortable, and you can buy tickets online.

I live in Székesfehérvár, between Budapest and the lake, so I could show you around. Why don't we spend a weekend at Balaton together?

Can't wait to see you!
Cheers,
Ádám

pointsCovered.quote: The best time to come is June, because it's warm but not too hot, and there aren't as many tourists as in August.
You really should see Budapest, especially the Parliament and the view from Gellért Hill. You should also visit Lake Balaton, which is famous for its beaches.
The easiest way to get around is by train. Trains are cheap and quite comfortable, and you can buy tickets online.
Why don't we spend a weekend at Balaton together?

notes: Feladat teljesítése: Tom mindhárom kérdésére válaszol (mikor, mit, hogyan), mindkét ajánlott helyhez indoklás tartozik, a záró bekezdésben pedig konkrét közös program szerepel.
Hangnem: baráti válaszlevél – reagál a hírre („that's great news!”), összevont alakok, „Cheers” elköszönés.
Szövegalkotás: négy bekezdés a négy szemponthoz; a „because”, „especially”, „also”, „so” és a „which” vonatkozó mellékmondat köti össze a gondolatokat.
Szókincs és nyelvhelyesség: felsőfok (the best time, the easiest way), hasonlítás (not as many tourists as) és helyes „should” + főnévi igenév.
Érdemes megtanulni: „The best time to come is … because …”, „It's famous for …”, „The easiest way to get around is by …”, „I could show you around.”
